subject: keyboard-focus-order
text: - An element is focusable if it holds a sub-document, or if it is not inert (by presence on itself or an ancestor element, `Node::is_inert`), is no disabled form control and either has `tabindex >= 0` or, with no tabindex, is an `<a>`/`<area>` with `href` or a `button`, `input`, `select`, `textarea`, `frame`, `iframe` or `summary` (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:742-774) — `disabled` read by its presence on a form control alone (`ElementData::is_disabled`: `can_be_disabled()` and the attribute present), any value, bare, `"false"` or `"true"`, so a `<div disabled tabindex=0>` takes focus; the Tab walk (`focus_next_node` / `focus_prev_node`), autofocus (a disabled form control or an inert candidate skipped) and `DioxusDocument::unkeyed_actionable` read it (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:516-520; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:743; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:563-580; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:889-930) — the presence reading ratified by the founder (2026-10-13, «По наличию (Рекомендую)», confirmed on the wrap's answer card on 2026-10-14 «Подтвердить (Рекомендую)», each by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option label), its narrowing to form controls and the `inert` read ratified by the founder (2026-10-18); HTML's focus fixup is built, in every document, so a node that holds focus when it becomes inert gives focus up at the flush, no DOM `blur` or `focusout` firing (the line below)

subject: keyboard-focus-order
text: - `DocumentMutator::flush` calls `BaseDocument::clear_focus` where `focus_node_id` resolves to a node reading `is_inert()`, in every document, with no `inert` arm joining the attribute writes, so a subtree moved under an inert box is covered too; no DOM `blur` or `focusout` fires, and `disabled` and `hidden` take no part in it (packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:1051-1063; tests/blitz-tests/tests/inert_subtree.rs:229-310) — as measured at escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-10-31-engine-debts/report.md

subject: keyboard-focus-order
text: - Tab moves focus to the next node and Shift+Tab to the previous, dispatching focus events (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:29-44); `focus_next_node` / `focus_prev_node` move focus to the next/previous focussable node (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:1854-1867)

subject: keyboard-focus-order
text: - Disabled-ness is keyed one way since 2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness: the `DISABLED`/`ENABLED` element state (hence `:disabled`) reads the attribute's PRESENCE, and the pointer-move gate, `ClickTarget::Disabled`, `handle_click`'s walk gate, the Enter and Space activation and focusability read `ElementData::is_disabled` — that presence on a `button`, `input`, `select` or `textarea` alone (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18) — so `disabled="false"` and a bare `disabled=""` on a form control match `:disabled` and are not focusable, and a bare `disabled` set after creation takes its focusability away (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:480-485; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:516-520; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:743; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:329; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:462; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:760; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:260; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:277; tests/blitz-tests/tests/focusability_updates.rs:59-62; tests/blitz-tests/tests/focusability_updates.rs:78-96; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:889-930) — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness/report.md; before it focusability parsed the value as a bool and both stayed focusable (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-06-headless-stand/evidence/disabled-false-probe.txt)

subject: keyboard-focus-restoration
text: - Clicking a non-interactive area clears focus (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:998-1001)

subject: keyboard-focus-restoration
text: - A pointer click on a `button` (any type) or an `input` of type `submit`, `reset` or `button` focuses it through `generate_focus_events` / `set_focus_to`, then submits the form owner when it is a submit button, and ends the walk matched — since 2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness, in every document; before it a submit button submitted without breaking the walk and every other button fell through to the unmatched clear of focus, so an accepted click on one left no element focused (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-scrolling-box-bounds-and-hit/report.md); a disabled form control still stops the walk first, a disabled ancestor `div` not (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18), a click on a `select` focuses it through `generate_focus_events` / `set_focus_to`, clearing its typeahead and the document's text selection, a disabled select stopped by the walk's gate first so it neither focuses nor acts, while an option of a closed single select, under a group too, is not clicked (a driver `click` on one is refused `covered` — on the stand the flight booker's two options among them), a `multiple` select's row taking a click through `handle_click`'s `option` arm (the line below) (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:875-888; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_select.rs:177-203; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_select.rs:240-261), and a click on any other element is unchanged — a CRUD row or the list still clears focus; on the stand a click focuses each stand button and Tab continues from it, and after an accepted driver `click` on `fx-before` it reads `focused` and is the tree's focus, in both layout modes (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:938-950; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:1056-1073; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:850-877; the restated `stand_act_obstructed`) — ratified by the founder (2026-10-13, «Клик даёт фокус (Рекомендую)», each by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option label) — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness/report.md

subject: keyboard-focus-restoration
text: - A click on a `multiple` select's row runs `click_select_row` behind `handle_click`'s `option` arm, in every document: a disabled select stops it; otherwise it focuses the select and clears the typeahead and the text selection, a plain click chooses the row alone, Ctrl or Meta flips it, Shift spans, and a disabled row changes nothing (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:1013-1054; tests/blitz-tests/tests/select_interaction.rs:601-664; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_select.rs:354-379) — as measured at escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-10-31-engine-debts/report.md

text: - A `details` or `dialog` carrying `open` holds the `OPEN` element state — `ElementData::flush_open_state`, run at element construction and on every `open` write or removal through the mutator — so `:open` matches it, in every document; activating a `details`'s first `summary` (above) toggles `open` through the mutator and so flips `:open`; `open_state` (4 tests, both layout modes) asserts `open` read from the attribute at construction, a write and a removal through the mutator moving it, and a summary's click and Enter flipping its `details` (tests/blitz-tests/tests/open_state.rs:54-143 — as measured at escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-10-31-engine-debts/report.md) (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:488-489; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:543-549; packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:372-375; packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:528-531; packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo.rs:510) — as measured at escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-10-27-upstream-sync-engine-debts/report.md

subject: keyboard-handling
text: - Text inputs handle arrow keys, Home/End, Delete/Backspace, Enter (newline or submit) and action-modifier copy/cut/paste/select-all, plus word movement with the action modifier (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/text.rs:202-370)

subject: keyboard-handling
text: - A focused `input type="range"` with no `disabled` attribute (read by presence) steps up on ArrowRight and ArrowUp, down on ArrowLeft and ArrowDown, goes to its minimum on Home and its maximum on End, and every other key does nothing — since 2026-10-13-range-input-interaction, in every document; its value is a current value held apart from the `value` attribute (`RangeInputData`), sanitized to `[min, max]` on the step grid, and each change marks the changed set and fires one `input` event, a move that changes nothing firing none (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:102-107; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:152-169; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:444-465) — ratified by the founder (2026-10-13, «Стрелки + Home/End (Рекомендую)», confirmed on the wrap's answer card «Подтвердить (Рекомендую)», each by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option label) — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-13-range-input-interaction/report.md

subject: keyboard-handling
text: - A focused single-choice `select` (no `multiple`) that is no disabled form control (`ElementData::is_disabled`) takes a pressed ArrowDown / ArrowUp to the next / previous enabled option and Home / End to the first / last enabled option (with none chosen, ArrowDown reads as Home and ArrowUp as End), and a character pressed with no Ctrl, Alt or Meta as typeahead — the first enabled option whose label starts with the text typed, compared in lower case, the text kept for one select until 1 s of the document's clock passes; every other key does nothing (Enter and Space open nothing, a released Space activates no select); each change marks the changed set, dispatches one `input` then one `change` carrying the select's value and asks for a redraw, a key that changes nothing firing none; an `optgroup`'s options are the select's own in tree order, a `multiple` select takes its own keys (the entries below), and no popup is painted (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:108-113; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:171-255; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:303-324; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:271-297; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/select.rs:274-292; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/select.rs:294-304) — as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-20-select-by-id/report.md

subject: keyboard-handling
text: - A focused `multiple` select that is no disabled form control takes ArrowDown, ArrowUp, Home and End: alone they choose that row alone, with Shift they span from the anchor, and with Ctrl or Meta they move the current row and change nothing (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:213-244; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:351-380; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/select.rs:317-358; tests/blitz-tests/tests/select_interaction.rs:523-556) — as measured at escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-10-31-engine-debts/report.md
